description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed prompts for creating medical multiple-choice questions (MCQs) with scenario-based instructions, explanations, and references.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive prompt for creating a medical MCQ based on difficulty, context, and optional image context, including detailed instructions and explanation format.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating a generated MCQ, focusing on accuracy, clarity, and scenario realism.
